description: Department of Agrarian Development - Determination of Areas of Agricultural Research and Production Assistant
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily deals with land and property-related matters by determining specific agricultural research and production areas within various administrative districts. It involves the classification and designation of land areas for agricultural purposes under the Agrarian Development Act, which falls under land use planning and zoning changes. The content focuses on geographical boundaries and administrative divisions rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
